Simulate a Steel Panel and Floor Point Cloud

Source: R/simulatePanelData.R
simulatePanelFloorCloud.Rd

Generates a simulated 3D point cloud representing a steel panel and its surrounding floor.

Usage

simulatePanelFloorCloud(
  mesh,
  nPanel = 1e+07,
  nFloor = 1e+06,
  prec = 0.5,
  sdPanel = 0.2,
  sdFloorZ = 0.2,
  marginXY = 20,
  gapZ = 2,
  seed = 1
)

Arguments

mesh

A theoretical mesh3d object representing the panel, typically obtained with preparePanelMesh().

nPanel

Number of points sampled from the panel surface. Default is 1e7.

nFloor

Number of points generated for the surrounding floor. Default is 1e6.

prec

Positive numeric value defining the truncation limits of the noise applied to the panel coordinates. Default is 0.5.

sdPanel

Standard deviation of the truncated normal noise applied to the panel coordinates. Default is 0.2.

sdFloorZ

Standard deviation of the vertical noise applied to the floor points. Default is 0.2.

marginXY

Additional distance used to extend the simulated floor beyond the panel bounding box. Default is 20.

gapZ

Vertical distance between the lowest point of the panel and the mean height of the simulated floor. Default is 2.

seed

Integer used to initialise the random number generator. Default is 1.

Value

A data frame with numeric columns X, Y, and Z. The first nPanel rows correspond to panel points and the remaining nFloor rows correspond to floor points.

Details

Panel points are sampled from a theoretical mesh3d surface using sampleMesh() and perturbed with truncated normal noise. Floor points are generated in four regions surrounding the panel in the XY plane.

Setting nFloor = 0 generates only points from the panel surface.

See also

preparePanelMesh(), sampleMesh()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data("cad", package = "dimControl")

meshTeor <- preparePanelMesh(cad)

data <- simulatePanelFloorCloud(
  mesh = meshTeor,
  nPanel = 1e7,
  nFloor = 1e6,
  seed = 1
)

dim(data)
head(data)

rgl::clear3d()
rgl::points3d(data, col = "gray")
rgl::decorate3d()
} # }
